_comment: Acceptance fixture: the destination file EXISTS and holds nothing. That is
the empty-array arm, and it is the only missing-carry arm a tree scan can
have: a carry file that was never created is not in the scan, so nothing
here can report it. Its absence is refused one layer up, by policy_lint's
--pr-body check on `## Forward-carry`, which errors on a destination not in
the tree -- EXISTENCE, not authorship. So two cases survive both layers: a
body naming a destination that is in the tree and received nothing this
round, and a pull request that OWED a carry and wrote `none`. Both need
knowing a finding existed, and both stay with the fix reviewer. See the
four-case block above checkCarryShape in brief_lint.mjs.
stage: acceptance probe standing in for a destination nobody wrote to
